name: Morning brief
title: Today's calendar, weather, world news and AI, on one page

accounts: Slack (the organisation's app, read for the person who connected it: what waits on him)
r/dadjokes on Reddit (its public feed of top posts, for the dad joke)
jobs: the morning brief, made each morning at the time set in Settings, Morning brief (rouh/morning_brief.py, Mornings)
touches.remove: Remove the Mornings loop from rouh/runtime.py, then rouh/morning_brief.py, rouh/slack_brief.py, rouh/web/brief.py, briefpage.js/.css and this manifest. Old briefs stay in morning_briefs until dropped.
